newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Airlines March load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Airlines March load factor rises.

text.p: Mesaba Airlines, a unit of Mesaba Holdings Inc, said Monday its passenger load factor in March was 53.1 percent, up from 52.3 percent a year ago.
Revenue passenger miles in the month were 43.2 million, up from 33.6 million a year ago, while available seat miles were 81.4 million, up from 64.3 million a year ago.

For the year through March, passenger load factor was 48.7 percent, up from 48.6 percent a year ago. Revenue passenger miles were 110.5 million, up from 90.7 million a year ago, while available seat miles were 226.9 million, up from 186.6 million a year ago.
Shares of Mesaba Holdings were up 3/8 at 12-3/8 Monday.
